items.title: AI-based model to help scrutinise Odisha pension cases
items.description: Odisha plans AI-based pension model to verify service records and pay fixation, aiming to speed up processing; departments asked to submit cadre and pay data.

items.title: Quanshium AI Core develops indigenous quantum-secure drone technology
items.description: Odisha-based start-up Quanshium AI Core has tested a quantum-secure drone communication link over 10 km using indigenous QRNG and post-quantum encryption technologies

items.title: Odisha eyes semiconductor push with five projects worth over $4 billion
items.description: The state aims to build a semiconductor and advanced electronics ecosystem, with projects spanning chip fabrication and 3D packaging, alongside investments in AI infrastructure

items.title: AI course for apprenticeship-linked degree students from 2nd semester of current session
items.description: Odisha to replace Good Citizenship with ‘AI for All’ VAC for AEDP students from 2026-27, boosting workplace-ready skills for apprenticeship-linked degrees.

items.title: AI boost for commissionerate police in financial fraud probes
items.description: Commissionerate police in Bhubaneswar to get AI financial investigation tool to speed fraud probes, trace fund flows, detect mule accounts and patterns.

items.title: Odisha police to hire 64 specialists for cyber crime coordination centre
items.description: Odisha Police to set up S4C cyber command centre, hiring 64 cyber experts and 60 helpline agents to boost forensics, AI analytics, and investigations.

items.title: Srikant Jena seeks transparency on proposed Naraj AI data centre project
items.description: Former Union minister Srikant Jena urges Odisha govt to disclose Naraj AI data centre MoU, power and water plans, incentives, jobs data, and EIA details.

items.title: CureBay raises ₹100 crore in Pre-Series C round to expand rural network
items.description: The Bhubaneswar-based healthtech firm raised Rs 69 crore in equity and over Rs 30 crore in debt to expand its rural clinic network and strengthen AI-powered healthcare services

items.title: Tata Power to set up ₹54 crore GCC in Odisha for next-gen energy solutions
items.description: Tata Power's new global capability centre in Odisha will develop AI-driven solutions for the energy sector, with an investment of Rs 54.31 crore and plans to create 110 skilled jobs.
